decisions: - Keep this unrelated draft scope for callers.
- The state-store owns the completed-run persistence contract.
acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] The state-store persists completed runs atomically.
documentationUpdates: - Document the state-store persistence API in operator runbook.
- Update the overview when both surfaces ship.

decisions: - The command-line entrypoint owns flag validation before dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] The CLI validates run flags before dispatch.
documentationUpdates: - Document CLI flag validation in install-and-config.

decisions: - Published plan paths are owned by persistence until shipped.
- Runtime surfaces must remain independently testable.
acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] SQLite storage retains the published plan path.
documentationUpdates: - Document SQLite plan-path storage in persistence docs.
- Cross-cutting runtime behavior is covered by integration tests.

decisions: - Daemon RPC must validate plan requests before dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] Daemon RPC rejects a malformed plan request.
documentationUpdates: - Document daemon RPC validation in operator runbook.

decisions: - The command-line entrypoint prints the published plan path.
acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] The CLI prints the published plan path.
documentationUpdates: - Document CLI plan-path printing in install-and-config.
